prompts.tier1_full: Sneddon 2D verification: 4 mm by 4 mm Steel_bench_2D_PE plate in plane strain with a horizontal pre-crack of length 1 mm from the left edge at mid-height. Bottom edge fully fixed. Top edge pulled vertically by 0.001 mm to load the crack. Run 100 steps. The expected behaviour is mode-I propagation from the crack tip with a load-displacement curve approaching the Sneddon analytical solution.
prompts.tier2_partial: steel plate with a small horizontal edge crack, analytical verification setup
prompts.tier3_figure_only: Reproduce the Sneddon analytical aperture profile for a pressurised line crack in plane strain, on a steel plate sized so finite-domain effects are small (e.g. crack length ≤ 1/4 of plate width).
